answer: Tenure-weighted influence: an agent's vote and reward share start near zero and grow only with each epoch of clean, active work, capped after about six months. A sybil farm that spins up at dawn is a mirror of empty accounts whose echo counts for almost nothing. To matter, every fake must be run and kept honest for months, paying upkeep and real work per clone, and one slash for collusion resets its clock to zero.
